messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from today's infra segment — drop clarifying Qs here and we'll answer live. Thanks everyone :wave:

simon: Linking the short infra notes I referenced: https://redwood.internal/infra/gpu-capacity (will post public summary later) :eyes:

alisha: APAC question — any concrete ETA for A100 pools in ap-southeast? Our EMEA+APAC customers keep pinging for latency improvements.

simon: Short answer: procurement is done for the first A100 batch. Shipping ETA mid-May, regional onboarding late-May. Initial capacity will be reserved for Dedicated/private beta and selected customers; hosted allocation follows once we validate autoscale. :rocket:

dan: On autoscaling: Hosted will keep reactive instance-pool autoscaling (fast for bursty traffic). Dedicated will get scale-from-zero & smoother ramp for queued batch jobs. We'll publish the exact policy table and metrics thresholds next week.

harini: Will free / trial orgs be able to spin APAC GPUs during rollout?

simon: Not at first. We’re gating APAC GPUs to paid orgs to prevent noisy traffic and for controlled testing. We expect to open quotas gradually.

kevin: If a region runs out of GPU capacity, what's the automatic fallback? Cross-region routing? CPU inference? Any SLA impact?

simon: Fallback order: 1) route to compatible quantized model variant in-region (same latency SLAs if compatible), 2) cross-region routing to nearest region with capacity (adds latency), 3) async CPU inference for low-priority jobs only. We will not fail open to CPU for realtime SLAs. SLA fallbacks will be surfaced in the Console.

oliver: Any expected change to token pricing because of the new pools/quant strategies?

alisha: No published token price changes. You may see lower effective cost-per-inference due to smarter batching and KV caching. Console estimates and the Optimize tab will show projected unit costs per route after rollout.

kevin: Can teams set hard region pinning for Dedicated to avoid cross-region routing?

dan: Yes — Dedicated customers can pin region preferences and disable cross-region failover. That will be a per-deployment setting in the rollout config.

maya: Quick one about observability — will the Console show when traffic gets routed off-region? We need that for incident playbooks.

simon: Yes, Console will get a routing-events view (live and historical) with tags for fallback reason (capacity/latency/maintenance). We'll push the first version as a flag for a subset of orgs in the next week.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled infra config update: gpu-pool-scaling.yml applied to staging at 2026-04-12T15:12Z :white_check_mark:

kevin: Could you paste the sample autoscale snippet you mentioned earlier?

dan: Sure — here's the early example we demoed:

```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 60
  scale_metric: requests_per_gpu
  target_rps_per_gpu: 1200
  scale_cooldown_sec: 30
```

alisha: Note — numbers above are placeholders. We will tune per model profile and workload.

maya: Thanks — final ask: Simon/EngInfra, can you send a short follow-up email with the rollout windows for each region + the public-facing FAQ we can share with customers? We'll pin it to the all-hands notes. :thumbsup:

simon: Yep — sending the followup doc by EOD with a TL;DR and expected dates for US/EMEA/APAC. I'll also add a migration checklist for teams that want to prefer Dedicated vs hosted.

maya: Awesome. If you had a question and haven't seen it answered, drop it here or DM Simon/Alisha. Closing thread after we post the doc. :slightly_smiling_face:
